name: Aasha Shrestha
quote: The tilt-and-turn windows cut the Ring Road noise. Rooms stay warmer through winter, and the team finished the whole house in a week.

name: Rajan Adhikari
quote: We specified anthracite for a shopfront in Patan. Hi-Tech matched the sample, and the frames went in on the date we agreed.
